title: Dice ladders
notes: The die sizes are read from the Calculator's literal `20 | 12 | 6` row (Calculator!I16:L16), and confirmed a second time by the six decompositions in Calculator!G17:N20 — 10 → 0D20 + 0D12 + 1D6 + 4 and 39 → 1D20 + 1D12 + 1D6 + 1 among them. Concept 07 calls it the best-confirmed mechanic in the ruleset, and `src/engine/dice/diceLadder.test.ts` pins all six rows.
`showZeroTerms` is true because the sheet writes `0D20` rather than dropping the rung — a display choice the export makes visibly, not an inference.
`remainder` is `flat`, which is the only value the type has (TICKET-ROLL-03). Concept 07 lists `smallest_die` and `drop` as alternatives; the sheet uses neither, so nothing is written for them.
**No `maxPerDie`.** The sheet caps nothing — 100 over this ladder is 5D20 there as it is here — so the key is absent rather than set to a number that would look confirmed.

One ladder, not one per roll: the sheet feeds every roll through the same `20 | 12 | 6` row. What each roll *puts into* it is a roll definition (Concept 08), which is still combat-skills.json's v1.0 shape until TICKET-ROLL-05.

diceLadders.name: Standard
diceLadders.description: The sheet's ladder: a value becomes D20s, then D12s, then D6s, with the leftover as a flat bonus.
